Spicy Lab, client review

Homepage redesign: a sultrier, cleaner direction

Every screen, shown statically. Desktop 1920 sits beside mobile 390.

  • Background

    Dark plum with a satin sheen behind the hero, returning softly behind Community and the footer so the page flows as one piece.

  • Buttons

    Glossy gradient Generate, frosted glass Use template, pearl-white Quick create. Each has its own icon disc so the action reads at a glance.

  • Quick create banner

    A satin feature panel beside the headline, showing the photo, video and template steps as three stacked cards.

  • Structure

    Search moves into the hero, filters sit in one slim bar, and section titles are set in an editorial serif with more space around them.
